title: Structure an argument
description: Practise framing, cleft emphasis, and rebuttal.

items.targetText: It is the quality of the evidence that determines the strength of the claim.
Admittedly the costs are high; nevertheless, the long-term gains outweigh them.

items.prompt: Deliver a 60-second argument: premise, one cleft emphasis, one rebuttal.
items.promptIt: Presenta un'argomentazione di 60 secondi: premessa, una cleft, una replica.
items.exampleAnswer: The premise is that transparency builds trust. It is clear criteria that strengthen public confidence. Admittedly costs rise initially; nevertheless, long-term gains outweigh them.
items.hint: Use premise, It is... that..., Admittedly / nevertheless
